newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish flood losses estimate by mid-August - GUS.
newsitem.headline: Polish flood losses estimate by mid-August - GUS.

text.p: Polish flood loss estimates, prepared by a team comprising various government branches, should be ready by mid-August, the Central Statistical Office (GUS), one of the bodies involved, said on Wednesday.

"Presently a taskforce is being formed and will begin to work in the upcoming days. GUS is part of the team...(which) by the middle of August will be able to give its preliminary loss estimates," GUS president Tadeusz Toczynski said.
Independent analysts have placed flood losses at around 7.5 billion zlotys while German insurance firm Munich Re said it would amount to 3-5 billion marks.
